info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程提供修習飛行課程之學生一基本相關知識，課程內容包括1. 介紹飛行操作相關氣動力學及飛機系統;2. 瞭解飛行環境及機場設施;3. 介紹大氣環境及其對飛行操作之影響
description.describe_eh: Develop an understanding of the fundamental concepts and ideas in aviation operations, Topics covered include: 1. Understanding of aerodynamic principles and introducing the basic of the airplane systems. 2. Learn to know about the flight environment and airport facilities. 3. Introducing the variable atmosphere and its effect on aircraft operations.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解飛機基本氣動力學及其裝置如何確保飛機之穩定性
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand the basic aerodynamic principles related to the four forces of flight and the design features that give airplanes their basic stability.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解飛行空域之構造、操作規定及飛行於該空域之裝備需求
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand the structure of the entire airspace system and the operation rules and equipment requirements that apply in each airspace segment.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解基本天氣原理及其如何影響飛機性能及飛行安全
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand the basic weather theory and its effect on aircraft performance and flying safety.
